expenses.home.you_gave.description: Header totals card label for money the business paid out (rendered red). Also the title of the add-entry screen in the 'gave' direction.

expenses.home.you_got.description: Header totals card label for money the business received (rendered green). Also the title of the add-entry screen in the 'got' direction.

expenses.home.search_hint.description: Placeholder/label of the search box above the party list on the Expenses home screen.

expenses.home.add_person.description: Label of the FAB on the Expenses home screen and the title of the add-party screen. (Renamed from 'Add person' — key name kept for compatibility.)

expenses.home.empty_title.description: Empty-state title on the Expenses home screen when no parties exist.

expenses.home.empty_message.value: Add a person to start recording what you gave and got.
expenses.home.empty_message.description: Empty-state message on the Expenses home screen when no parties exist.

expenses.add_person.name_label.description: Label of the required name field on the add-person screen.

expenses.add_person.phone_label.description: Label of the optional phone field on the add-person screen.

expenses.add_person.pick_contact.description: Explanation/content description of the contact-picker icon button next to the phone field.

expenses.add_person.contact_error.value: Couldn't get the number from contacts
expenses.add_person.contact_error.description: Snackbar shown when the system contact picker returns nothing usable or is unavailable.

expenses.add_person.name_required.description: Validation error under the name field when saving with an empty name.

expenses.add_person.exists_notice.description: Toast shown when saving a person whose name already exists; the app steers to the existing party's ledger instead of creating a duplicate. {name} is the existing party's name.

expenses.add_person.business_question.description: Title of the yes/no pill selector on the add-party screen asking whether the party is business-related. {business} is the business name. Yes = business-related (default, counted in financial reports); No = personal. Options reuse common.action.yes / common.action.no.

expenses.party.personal_tag.description: Badge shown on party list rows and the ledger header for parties marked personal (not associated with the business). Personal parties are excluded from financial reports and appear only in the personal-expenses report.

expenses.party.menu.description: Long-press explanation and content description of the party-level overflow (edit/delete) icon in the ledger header / party row.

expenses.party.edit_title.description: Title of the edit-party dialog/screen (name, phone, business flag — same fields as add-party). Buttons reuse common.action.save / common.action.cancel.

expenses.party.delete_action.description: Menu action that starts deleting a party (opens the confirmation dialog).

expenses.party.delete_confirm_title.description: Title of the confirmation dialog before deleting a party. {name} is the party's name.

expenses.party.delete_confirm_message.value: All entries and attached bills of this party will be deleted too. This cannot be undone.
expenses.party.delete_confirm_message.description: Body of the party delete confirmation dialog, warning that every ledger transaction and its attached bill files are deleted along with the party. Confirm/dismiss buttons reuse common.action.delete / common.action.cancel.

expenses.party.deleted_notice.description: Snackbar/toast confirmation after a party (with all their entries and attachments) was deleted. {name} is the deleted party's name.

expenses.ledger.you_gave_button.description: Big red bottom button on the person ledger that starts a new 'paid' entry.

expenses.ledger.you_got_button.description: Big green bottom button on the person ledger that starts a new 'received' entry.

expenses.ledger.balance_after.description: Chip on each ledger row showing the running balance after that entry. {amount} is a formatted rupee amount.

expenses.ledger.net_balance_label.description: Label above the party's overall net balance in the ledger header.

expenses.ledger.empty_title.description: Empty-state title on a person's ledger with no entries.

expenses.ledger.empty_message.value: Use the buttons below to record what you gave or got.
expenses.ledger.empty_message.description: Empty-state message on a person's ledger with no entries.

expenses.ledger.pending_upload.value: Waiting to upload to Google Drive
expenses.ledger.pending_upload.description: Long-press explanation and content description of the pending-upload badge on an attachment that has not reached Google Drive yet.

expenses.ledger.delete_title.description: Title of the confirmation dialog before deleting a ledger entry.

expenses.ledger.delete_message.value: The entry will be removed from the ledger.
expenses.ledger.delete_message.description: Body of the confirmation dialog before deleting a ledger entry.

expenses.ledger.entry_menu.description: Long-press explanation and content description of the per-entry overflow (edit/delete) icon on a ledger row.

expenses.ledger.attachment_thumbnail.description: Content description of an attachment thumbnail on a ledger row.

expenses.entry.amount_label.description: Label of the plain numeric amount field on the add-entry screen.

expenses.entry.amount_error.description: Validation error under the amount field when the input is not a positive rupee amount.

expenses.entry.date_label.description: Label of the entry-date field on the add-entry screen (defaults to today).

expenses.entry.notes_label.description: Label of the optional notes field on the add-entry screen.

expenses.entry.attach_title.description: Section heading above the attachment buttons on the add-entry screen.

expenses.entry.attach_camera.description: Button that captures an invoice photo with the camera.

expenses.entry.attach_gallery.description: Button that picks an invoice image from the gallery/photo picker.

expenses.entry.attach_pdf.description: Button that picks an invoice PDF from the document picker.

expenses.entry.attach_limit.value: You can attach up to {count} files
expenses.entry.attach_limit.description: Snackbar shown when the user tries to attach more than the maximum number of files. {count} is that maximum.

expenses.entry.attach_failed.description: Snackbar shown when a picked or captured file could not be read or compressed.

expenses.entry.remove_attachment.description: Long-press explanation and content description of the remove (X) button on a pending attachment chip.

expenses.google_prompt.title.value: Back up invoices to Google Drive?
expenses.google_prompt.title.description: Title of the prompt shown after saving an entry with attachments while no Google account is linked.

expenses.google_prompt.message.value: Connect Google to keep attached invoices safely in your Drive. Files wait on this phone until then.
expenses.google_prompt.message.description: Body of the link-Google prompt; explains that attachments stay local (pending) until Google is connected.

expenses.google_prompt.connect.description: Positive button of the link-Google prompt (linking flow arrives with Settings).

expenses.google_prompt.later.description: Dismiss button of the link-Google prompt; the user can link later from Settings.

expenses.a11y.back.description: Content description of the back navigation arrow on Expenses screens.
